question_or_symptom: A model callback or handshake can appear device-free while upstream libhsakmt still links or probes production GPU paths.
observation: The pinned libhsakmt source and CMake retain direct KFD, DRM, AMDGPU, sysfs, and device-node paths, while the CP-0009 provider audit reports no production GPU DSO dependency and no forbidden device-node access.
conclusion: No-device behavior is a dependency and syscall boundary, not just a runtime callback choice.
decision: Keep upstream hardware paths as an exclusion audit and require a project-owned shim/daemon translation with readelf, ldd, source-token, and negative device checks before enabling any KFD/DRM operation.
invalidated_assumptions: Routing one model DRM callback removes every production hardware dependency.
A successful transport handshake proves that KFD or DRM was not touched.
